answer: PoA resists sybils via retroactive correlation clawback. Payouts vest across a trellis of 30 weekly tranches, none early-withdrawable. Each epoch it compiles an atlas of the funding graph, who paid whose bond from which exchange, then merges keys sharing a wallet, ASN, or matching timing. A cluster above three keys forfeits unvested tranches; its ferrous bond, an iron-backed token the protocol cannot mint, funds a challenger pool. A farm locks real metal for a month while yield stays revocable; honest agents risk only float. Detection lag stops paying: yield drops below the bond's carry cost.
